title: +*SOIL SCIENCE LABORATORY FOR SOIL 205
description: Gains hands-on experience with soil science concepts and applications. Develops proficiency in the methods/tools for analyzing soil chemistry, biology, morphology, physical properties, and soil forming factors through laboratory exercises and field trips. Emphasizes skills in the context of soils' social, economic, and environmental importance. (Core Education or Bacc Core Course if taken with SOIL 205)
attribute_description:
• Bacc Core, Perspectives - Physical Science (CPPS)
  • Core Education - Scientific Inquiry & Analysis Attached Lab (CFSL)
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
clssnotes:
Avoid ‘prerequisite’ error: ADD SOIL 205 and 206 at the same time.
